description:
Halo, Fortnite, Call of Duty, Elden Ring, Cyberpunk 2077—they’re more than just games. In this video, we’re unmasking the hidden agenda behind the gaming industry, revealing who really controls gaming and why you might be part of their mission. From blockbuster titles to soon-released hits, this investigation exposes how gamers are being shaped, steered, and watched.
If you care about games like Halo, Fortnite, God of War Ragnarök, Starfield or the next big MMORPG—this isn’t just another “what’s next” video. It’s a wake-up call about who’s in control.
